matrikaMeaning: Matrika means the nurturing, motherly energy of healing — treating from the depth and vibration of natural sources, guided by the wisdom of homoeopathy.
heading: A Practice Built on Listening
bio1: Dr. Puja founded Matrika Homoeopathy with a simple belief: real healing begins when a doctor truly listens. Every consultation starts with a detailed case history — your physical symptoms, daily habits, emotional state, and family history — because homeopathy treats the person, not just the diagnosis.
bio2: She works with patients of all ages, from young children to seniors, treating both acute complaints and long-standing chronic conditions. Her approach blends classical homeopathic principles with an honest, modern bedside manner: clear communication, realistic expectations, and consistent follow-up.
bio3: Consultations are available both in-clinic and online, so patients can continue their care wherever they are.
areasOfFocus: Chronic conditions, women's health, pediatric care, skin & respiratory complaints
